What We Offer

Medical Billing & Revenue Cycle Services

ProtoMed is a trusted medical billing company that helps healthcare practices get paid faster, reduce claim denials, and grow their revenue. We handle your entire revenue cycle from medical coding to accounts receivable recovery so you can focus on patient care.

Get a Free Revenue Audit

What We Offer

Our Medical Billing Services

We offer complete healthcare billing and RCM services for practices of all sizes. Each service is designed to reduce your workload, speed up payments, and protect your revenue.

  • 01

    Medical Billing Services

    We handle the full claims process from start to finish. Our certified billers submit accurate, clean claims to all major insurance payers so you get reimbursed quickly and in full every time.

    • Full claims process, start to finish
    • Clean claims to all major payers
    • Fast, full reimbursement
    Learn More about Medical Billing Services
  • 02

    Medical Coding Services

    Our AAPC and AHIMA certified coders assign the right CPT and ICD-10 codes to every encounter. Accurate coding means fewer denials, lower audit risk, and maximum reimbursement for your practice.

    • AAPC & AHIMA certified coders
    • Accurate CPT & ICD-10 coding
    • Fewer denials, lower audit risk
    Learn More about Medical Coding Services
  • 03

    Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)

    We manage your entire revenue cycle from patient registration to final payment. You get full financial transparency, monthly reports, and a steady cash flow with no surprises.

    • Registration to final payment
    • Full financial transparency
    • Monthly reports, steady cash flow
    Learn More about Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)
  • 04

    Credentialing & Provider Enrollment

    We take care of all the paperwork to enroll your providers with insurance companies fast. Get in-network with Medicare, Medicaid, and all major commercial payers without the administrative headache.

    • Fast provider enrollment
    • In-network with Medicare & Medicaid
    • All major commercial payers
    Learn More about Credentialing & Provider Enrollment
  • 05

    Denial Management

    We investigate every denied claim, find the root cause, correct the errors, and re-submit for payment. Our proactive denial management process recovers revenue your practice deserves.

    • Root-cause investigation
    • Errors corrected & re-submitted
    • Recovers revenue you deserve
    Learn More about Denial Management
  • 06

    Accounts Receivable (A/R) Recovery

    Old unpaid claims are costing you money. Our A/R recovery specialists follow up on aging balances and outstanding claims to clear your backlog and bring in the revenue you are owed.

    • Follow-up on aging balances
    • Clears your claim backlog
    • Recovers revenue you are owed
    Learn More about Accounts Receivable (A/R) Recovery
  • 07

    Appointment Scheduling

    We manage patient scheduling to reduce no-shows, fill your calendar, and keep your practice running at full capacity. More appointments mean more revenue and better patient experience.

    • Reduces patient no-shows
    • Fills your calendar
    • Keeps you at full capacity
    Learn More about Appointment Scheduling
  • 08

    EHR & EMR Migration

    Switching EHR or billing systems? We manage the entire migration process — data transfer, system setup, and staff training — with zero disruption to your daily clinical operations or revenue flow.

    • Full data transfer & setup
    • Hands-on staff training
    • Zero disruption to operations
    Learn More about EHR & EMR Migration

Benefits of Choosing Our Services

You get a single accountable partner for everything from the first code to the final payment — one team that knows your practice, protects your revenue, and answers for every result.
